cover.sub: 5 niche habits of european founders who
cover.title: launch to the us first

inner.title: keep r&d home
inner.body: they move sales and leadership to the us and keep engineers in europe. european engineers earn about half the us rate for the same role.
inner.label: half the salary

inner.title: flip before pricing
inner.body: us seed investors often want a delaware parent. flipping after a priced round usually costs more in legal fees than registering both from day one.
inner.label: late = pricey

inner.title: count your days
inner.body: they log every day spent in the us. 140 days a year for three years makes you a us tax resident under the irs test.
inner.label: 183 weighted

inner.title: watch each state
inner.body: they track us sales state by state. since wayfair, $100,000 of sales into one state can mean sales tax, even for a european seller.
inner.label: no office needed

inner.title: eu inc isn't law
inner.body: brussels proposed a 48 hour, under €100 eu company in march 2026. until it passes, 23% of european founders would pick the us if starting over.
inner.label: not yet

closer.HEADLINE:
you're not leaving europe.
you're renting america
